newsitem.title: CANADA: Windstar proposes merger with Denali.
newsitem.headline: Windstar proposes merger with Denali.

text.p: Windstar Energy Ltd said on Thursday it proposed to Denali Petroleums Ltd that they enter into an amalgamation on the basis of one common share of Windstar for each common share of Denali.
Windstar said it received executed lock-up agreements with management, directors and major shareholders of Denali representing about 57 percent of the outstanding common shares of Denali.
Denali shareholders will be asked to approve the proposed amalgamation at a special meeting to be called shortly.
Windstar said the amalgamation will benefit the current shareholders of both companies and will provide Windstar with increased oil production, cash flow, and development opportunities.
Upon successful completion of the proposed amalgamation, Windstar will have an asset base of about C$6 million, daily production of about 275 BOE and about 12.5 million shares outstanding.
